paragraphs: The M5 Touring is the first-ever M5 wagon, introduced in 2024 as part of the G99 generation alongside the G90 saloon. It uses the S68 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 with hybrid assistance, making it the most powerful production M5 ever. The S68 is a significant update from the previous S63, with a new crankshaft, revised oil cooler, different turbocharger configuration, and BMW's first-ever electric VANOS system. Because the M5 Touring is so new, no real-world long-term reliability pattern has emerged yet — we treat every S68 rebuild to the same high standard as our other M5 work.
about.boldParagraph: The M5 Touring is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 with hybrid assistance, fitted to the M5 Touring (G99) from 2024. The S68 is confirmed as a nut-and-bolt different design from the earlier S63 — new crankshaft, oil cooler, turbochargers, and first-ever electric VANOS. The hybrid system adds additional complexity, which we're fully equipped to service alongside the core engine rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your S68 BMW M5 Touring

compatibility.intro: The M5 Touring uses a single confirmed engine, the S68 hybrid V8, across the G99 generation. Unlike earlier M5 generations that switched engines partway through their runs — for example, the E39's S62, the E60's S85, or the F10/F90's S63 — the G99 is a single-engine generation from launch.
